name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-graph-flow-approval
description: Use when a flow node must wait for a human decision before acting: it implements the flow-api approval seam (one pending request per node attempt, single-use answers scoped to one run, configurable auto-deny timeout, cancellation, actor/time audit facts) and broadcasts the pending and settled requests as Cordis events; skip it when flows run unattended and approval-gated calls should keep failing closed.
